title: Meta ordered to pay $25B in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal | TechCrunch
summary: On Wednesday, a judge ordered the social media giant to initiate its biggest payout yet: $25 billion to the state of New Mexico for the tech giant’s role in deceiving resident users over its data privacy practices, The New York Times reports…
